summary: This bill directs NASA to continue its research on unmanned aircraft systems and advanced air mobility, including autonomous capabilities, in collaboration with the FAA and other entities, and requires a briefing to Congress on the research progress.

scores.thoughts: The bill directs NASA to continue its research on unmanned aircraft systems and advanced air mobility in collaboration with other agencies and industry. While it doesn't explicitly appropriate new funds, continuing research implies ongoing or potentially increased government expenditure for these activities. This is a central directive of the bill.
